authoring_rules.source: one to one: the frame is Heading 1, the page heading line is the page's h1, content Heading N is hN from Heading 2 down
authoring_rules.legacy: a frame at Heading 2 is read with an offset of one and reported as FRAME_LEVEL_LEGACY; the normalizer rewrites it

authoring_rules.source: bracket attributes tone=<name> from the template palette or color=#hex; default, gold, grey in composite-navy
the page template's modest inline set by default; plain on request
Exact title in the Assignment/Discussion/Quiz declaration; normalization may carry an explicitly mapped heading into that declaration.
authoring_rules.fallback: No inferred prefix or fuzzy match in direct authoring; mapped legacy behavior is explicit in the course map.
None for a grade-linked activity: missing activity points are an error even when the grading plan states a value.
authoring_rules.on_disagreement: The join check reports POINTS_DIFFER_FROM_GRADE_ROW as a warning. The build blocks until points_determinations explicitly selects activity or points_table; the determination is recorded.
authoring_rules.decided: owner, 2026-10-06; behavior and missing-points policy clarified 2026-10-09

authoring_rules.alternative: the points table row (build setting grade_item_names)

authoring_rules.source: listed in the blueprint, or built from the week's activities when the checklist says so
term calendar and due-day rules in the build settings; an activity may override its rule
Authorized course-map entries for authored wording; explicit activity rename writes only structural references and link targets to a new copy, with authorizer and reason.
authoring_rules.note: Narrative wording and body headings are not rewritten by structural rename.

source_change_handling.evidence: synthetic fixture with added and removed paragraphs; MBA 620 across two same-day exports with no position change; MBA 620 against a simulated export with eleven paragraphs removed, which rebuilt to a byte-identical package; synthetic fixture with a paragraph added between stretches (joins, reported), one inside a range (comes along), and one above the title (refused)
source_change_handling.limit: a paragraph new in the later export that sits inside a mapped stretch comes along; one between two stretches joins the content stretch ending just before it in the same cell or body and is reported as an inference to confirm (placed_by_inference); one with no mapped content neighbour in its container is left unplaced and the normalizer refuses it. Content, intro, notes, and retired lists grow; lists of paragraphs to act on never do. Rule of 2026-10-08
